paragraphs.text: Wednesday brought more rain to the Pontotoc Experiment Station in one day than the gauge had collected in the first 24 days of November. Mississippi State University Extension recorded 1.85 inches on Nov. 25, bringing the station’s total to 3.20 inches through Wednesday.

Before Wednesday, the biggest daily reading this month was 0.80 inches on Nov. 1. The gauge recorded 0.24 inches on Monday, Nov. 23, and zero on Tuesday. The whole stretch from Nov. 1 through Tuesday added up to 1.35 inches.

Just over half an inch came in two morning hours. The station’s 7 a.m. entry showed 0.27 inches, followed by 0.25 inches at 8 a.m. The hourly table also shows rain through the afternoon and into Wednesday evening.

The readings come from one gauge south of the city of Pontotoc. Rainfall elsewhere in the county can differ. The Delta Agricultural Weather Center publishes both the daily totals and the hourly readings for the station.
